Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 48px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
